prompt: The attached image is a 240x242 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one

function rnd(){seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;}

const gc=grain.getContext('2d'), pix=gc.createImageData(64,64);

 const n=rnd();
 pix.data[i]=Math.round(239+n*16);
 pix.data[i+1]=Math.round(177+n*25);
 pix.data[i+2]=Math.round(36+n*18);
 pix.data[i+3]=255;
}
gc.putImageData(pix,0,0);
const yellowTexture=new THREE.CanvasTexture(grain);
yellowTexture.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
yellowTexture.wrapS=yellowTexture.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;

const yellow=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:yellowTexture,color:'#ffd45b',roughness:1});

const sphereGeo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28);

function group(parent,name){const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;parent.add(g);return g;}
function ball(parent,name,p,s,mat=yellow){
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeo,mat);
 m.name=name;m.position.set(...p);m.scale.set(...s);
 m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m;
}
const hairGeo=new THREE.ConeGeometry(.0025,.024,3);
hairGeo.translate(0,.009,0);
function fuzzy(parent,name,p,s,mat=yellow,count=1600){
 const g=group(parent,name);g.position.set(...p);g.scale.set(...s);
 ball(g,'solid-surface',[0,0,0],[1,1,1],mat);
 if(count){
  const hairs=new THREE.InstancedMesh(hairGeo,mat===cream?cream:furMat,count);
  const d=new THREE.Object3D(),up=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const y=2*rnd()-1,a=rnd()*Math.PI*2,r=Math.sqrt(1-y*y);
   const n=new THREE.Vector3(r*Math.cos(a),y,r*Math.sin(a));
   d.position.copy(n).multiplyScalar(.998);
   d.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up,n);
   d.scale.setScalar(.65+rnd()*.75);d.updateMatrix();hairs.setMatrixAt(i,d.matrix);
  }
  hairs.name='short-plush-fibers';g.add(hairs);
 }
 return g;
}
function tube(parent,name,points,radii,mat=yellow){
 const pts=points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p));
 const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
 const rings=36,sides=14,positions=[],indices=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=rings;i++){
  const t=i/rings,c=curve.getPoint(t),tangent=curve.getTangent(t).normalize();
  let side=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1).cross(tangent);
  if(side.lengthSq()<.01)side.set(1,0,0).cross(tangent);
  side.normalize();
  const other=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(tangent,side).normalize();
  const f=t*(radii.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(f),radii.length-2);
  const r=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[j],radii[j+1],f-j);
  for(let k=0;k<=sides;k++){
   const a=k/sides*Math.PI*2;
   const v=c.clone().addScaledVector(side,Math.cos(a)*r).addScaledVector(other,Math.sin(a)*r);
   positions.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
   if(i<rings&&k<sides){
    const q=i*(sides+1)+k;
    indices.push(q,q+sides+1,q+1,q+1,q+sides+1,q+sides+2);
   }
  }
 }
 const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
 geo.setIndex(indices);geo.computeVertexNormals();
 const g=group(parent,name);
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;g.add(mesh);
 ball(g,'rounded-start',points[0],[radii[0],radii[0],radii[0]],mat);
 const r=radii[radii.length-1];
 ball(g,'rounded-end',points[points.length-1],[r,r,r],mat);
 return g;
}
function line(parent,name,pts,r,mat){return tube(parent,name,pts,Array(pts.length).fill(r),mat);}
function box(parent,name,p,s,mat){
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(...s),mat);m.name=name;
 m.position.set(...p);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m;
}
function rod(parent,name,a,b,r,mat){
 const va=new THREE.Vector3(...a),vb=new THREE.Vector3(...b);
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,va.distanceTo(vb),12),mat);
 m.name=name;m.position.copy(va).add(vb).multiplyScalar(.5);
 m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),vb.sub(va).normalize());
 m.castShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m;
}

const notebook=group(scene,'open-notebook');

const spineX=-.26;
function pageY(u,v,side){return .864+.035*Math.sin(u*Math.PI*.85)+.016*u+.012*Math.sin(v*Math.PI)*u;}
function makePage(side){
 const g=group(notebook,side<0?'left-page':'right-page');
 const width=side<0?1.38:1.10;
 const pos=[],uv=[],ind=[],nx=20,nz=16;
 for(let j=0;j<=nz;j++)for(let i=0;i<=nx;i++){
  const u=i/nx,v=j/nz;
  const x=spineX+side*width*u;
  const z=.77+v*1.20+.10*u*(side<0?1:-1);
  pos.push(x,pageY(u,v,side),z);uv.push(u,v);
  if(i<nx&&j<nz){
   const q=j*(nx+1)+i;
   if(side<0)ind.push(q,q+1,q+nx+1,q+1,q+nx+2,q+nx+1);
   else ind.push(q,q+nx+1,q+1,q+1,q+nx+1,q+nx+2);
  }
 }
 const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
 geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
 geo.setIndex(ind);geo.computeVertexNormals();
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,paper);mesh.receiveShadow=true;mesh.castShadow=true;g.add(mesh);
 for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
  line(g,'layered-paper-edge-'+k,[
   [spineX,.851-k*.007,1.97],
   [spineX+side*width*.55,.871-k*.007,1.97+.055*(side<0?1:-1)],
   [spineX+side*width,.88-k*.007,1.97+.10*(side<0?1:-1)]
  ],.006,paperEdge);
 }
 const marks=[];
 for(let row=0;row<10;row++){
  const v=.13+row*.060;
  for(let word=0;word<5;word++){
   const base=.17+word*.14;
   if(side<0&&row<4&&word<2)continue;
   const length=.055+rnd()*.065;
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    const u1=base+k*.028,u2=Math.min(.94,u1+length*.45);
    const z1=.77+v*1.2+.10*u1*(side<0?1:-1);
    const z2=.77+(v+(rnd()-.5)*.008)*1.2+.10*u2*(side<0?1:-1);
    marks.push(spineX+side*width*u1,pageY(u1,v,side)+.003,z1);
    marks.push(spineX+side*width*u2,pageY(u2,v,side)+.003,z2);
   }
  }
 }
 const mg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 mg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(marks,3));
 g.add(new THREE.LineSegments(mg,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:'#827f72',transparent:true,opacity:.35})));
}
